faq: Do you contact buyers outside Amazon?
Never. Amazon requires all buyer communication to go through its messaging, and we follow that. We also do not ask buyers for reviews, or offer anything in exchange for one.
Can you issue refunds and returns?
Yes, in line with your policy and a refund limit you set. For amounts above it, we ask you first. We never change your bank or payout details.
Will buyer messages meet Amazon's 24 hour rule?
Amazon expects a reply within 24 hours. During the sprint we check your messages on working days and reply inside that window. If you need weekend cover, the add-on or a monthly plan can provide it.
If Amazon loses or damages your stock in its warehouse, you may be owed a refund. We check your reports for such cases and file claims with the evidence. Amazon decides each one.
